answer: Random Beacon Identity Lottery. Each epoch a public comet beacon emits unpredictable seeds; an agent's identity slot is valid only if a hash of its key with the seed lands in a small quota. Attackers cannot precompute placements, so sybil keys must be generated after each seed reveals. Because quotas cap valid slots per seed, an attacker pays ongoing keygen and registration costs per surviving identity while most decoys fail. This keeps the sybil haven costly and lets honest agents regrow like willow after resets.
